Application Deployment: Deploy and maintain applications across development, staging and production environments for various clientele projects. System Integration: Integrate project applications with client enterprise systems, platforms and services, including identity management, access control and other corporate systems. Automated Testing and Quality Assurance: Establish and maintain automated test coverage, perform debugging and resolve application defects and performance issues. Enable Data Teams: Productionise and operationalise data science and analytics solutions by packaging models, scripts and analyses into maintainable and deployable applications. Process Automation: Identify and implement automation opportunities to minimise downtime, reduce manual intervention and improve deployment and operational efficiency. Operations & Production Support (Run) Monitoring and Observability: Monitor deployed applications and runtime environments across production and non-production environments to ensure system performance and stability. Set up and maintain monitoring and alerting mechanisms. Incident and Change Management: Respond to application incidents, conduct problem investigations, collaborate with internal project teams and client stakeholders to resolve issues promptly, and escalate where necessary. Adhere to established change management processes for production deployments. Security and Access Control: Implement and maintain security measures and access controls for privileged access to testing and production environments, in accordance with client security policies and compliance requirements. Production Support: Provide day-to-day operational support, including occasional off-hours support for production incidents and scheduled maintenance activities. Operations Documentation: Develop and maintain operational runbooks, environment configurations and process documentation in accordance with client architecture standards, operational guidelines and audit requirements. Infrastructure Collaboration: Work closely with infrastructure engineers and client technical teams on environment and infrastructure matters. Possess a good understanding of cloud services, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and networking fundamentals to facilitate effective collaboration, without necessarily owning infrastructure management directly. Key Experiences and Qualifications Educational Background Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Professional Experience 3+ years of relevant experience in Operations, DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) roles. Demonstrated experience working independently as the primary or sole engineer on a product or project, with minimal technical supervision. Experience operating and supporting applications in production environments, including incident response and troubleshooting. Experience supporting application deployment and operations across multiple project environments. Technical Expertise CI/CD and Infrastructure Proficiency , including: Containerisation technologies such as Docker and cloud services, particularly AWS (ECS/Fargate, Lambda, S3, RDS/Aurora). CI/CD tooling and pipeline design (e.g. GitLab CI). Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g. Terraform) and environment management. Monitoring and Observability: Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as CloudWatch and Grafana, as well as Application Performance Management (APM) practices. Programming and Scripting: Familiarity with Python sufficient to collaborate with data science teams and productionise data science and analytics solutions. Problem-Solving and Working Style Self-directed and resourceful, with the ability to scope, plan and deliver work with minimal day-to-day technical guidance. Ability to break down complex and ambiguous technical problems into manageable and actionable tasks. Comfortable engaging with client stakeholders, infrastructure teams and enterprise system owners to clarify technical requirements, integration needs and operational procedures. Additional Skills (Bonus Points) Experience working on enterprise client projects involving complex system integrations and security or compliance requirements. Experience supporting data science, analytics or machine learning-related products. Experience with IT Service Management (ITSM) tools and established change and incident management workflows. Experience working with cloud-based application environments and enterprise technology ecosystems.

review_candidates.company: Zero to One Search | Recruitment Agency
review_candidates.description: Mechanisms Engineer - Solar Arrays Location: Germering, on-site About the hiring company: Dcubed is a fast-growing space engineering company with the mission to make space engineering and exploration easy and accessible. What makes Dcubed special is that each of us is a space explorer at heart. At Dcubed, we enable the future of space missions with high-performance, flight-proven release mechanisms and deployable structures. From cutting-edge Release Actuators to scalable Deployable Solar Arrays and innovative Deployable Antennas, our technologies are designed for user friendliness, availability, and reliability — whether for smallsats in LEO or large missions to Moon, Mars and beyond. About the role In space, there are no second chances. As Mechanisms Engineer – Solar Arrays (f/m/d) , you will be responsible for the deployment systems at the heart of dcubed's solar arrays. You will design, prototype, test, and qualify the hardware that allows spacecraft to generate power once they reach orbit. We are looking for an engineer with a builder's mindset: someone who can move seamlessly from CAD models and FEM analyses to the workshop and test lab, turning ambitious ideas into reliable flight hardware. If you are motivated by ownership, speed, and the challenge of making space mechanisms work where repair is impossible, you'll fit right in. Responsibilities Mechanism Design & Development: Design, analyze, and develop space-qualified deployment mechanisms and motion systems for Solar Array products, from concept through flight hardware delivery. Technical Expertise: Provide expert guidance on mechanism design, materials selection, lubrication, coatings, thermal effects, motorization margins, tolerancing, and reliability for space applications. Manufacturing & Prototyping: Apply Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles, generate production-ready technical drawings, and support rapid prototyping and manufacturing activities using additive manufacturing and conventional machining techniques. System Integration: Ensure seamless integration of mechanisms with structural, electrical, and deployment subsystems while balancing performance, manufacturability, cost, and schedule requirements. Testing & Qualification: Define, support, and execute development, qualification, and acceptance test campaigns, including deployment, vibration, thermal vacuum, shock, and lifetime testing. Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement: Investigate anomalies, perform root-cause analysis, and implement design improvements to enhance mechanism performance, reliability, and manufacturability. Documentation: Maintain engineering documentation including CAD models, technical drawings, specifications, analyses, test procedures, and qualification reports. Candidate requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline. 5+ years of experience in mechanism design, aerospace engineering, precision mechanical systems, or related fields. Strong knowledge of space mechanisms, including bearings, gears, springs, hinges, release systems, lubrication, coatings, wear mechanisms, thermal effects, and motorization sizing and margins. Expert-level CAD proficiency (SolidWorks preferred) and familiarity with FEM tools (ANSYS preferred). Strong understanding of materials, manufacturing processes, GD&T, tolerancing, and technical drawing generation. Experience applying Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles. Hands-on experience with prototyping and fabrication methods including 3D printing, milling, turning, laser cutting, CNC machining, and hardware assembly. Familiarity with space qualification methods and standards, including vibration, shock, thermal vacuum, deployment, and lifetime testing. Knowledge of ECSS, NASA, or equivalent aerospace standards is highly desirable. Fluent English skills. Eligibility to work in Germany. Feel free to apply here or directly via https://dcubed.teamtailor.com/jobs/8186378-mechanisms-engineer-solar-arrays-f-m-d

Heb jij ervaring in de verkoop van onderhoudsoplossingen in industriële omgevingen? Value-based selling · Salesstrategie · Teammanagement Als Managing Director draag je de volledige verantwoordelijkheid voor Interflon België. Je bouwt voort op een sterke basis en geeft richting aan de commerciële en organisatorische transformatie van de onderneming. Je combineert strategische verantwoordelijkheid met zichtbare aanwezigheid bij jouw team en je klanten. Daarbij maak je de toegevoegde waarde van Interflon concreet: hogere betrouwbaarheid en output van installaties, lagere TCO, minder energie- en materiaalverbruik en aantoonbare onderhoudsbesparingen. Wat ga je doen? Je draagt de eindverantwoordelijkheid voor de Belgische P&L, groei, winstgevendheid en duurzame waardecreatie. Je leidt en inspireert een compact team van 15 fte, met onder meer de Operations Manager, Sales Manager en Technical Manager. Samen met deze drie collega’s vorm je het managementteam. Je stimuleert de verdere omschakeling naar consultative en value-based selling. Je brengt het concept Lubrication as a Service (LaaS) succesvol naar de Belgische markt. Je versterkt bestaande key accounts, ontwikkelt nieuwe commerciële kansen en versnelt de groei in Franstalig België. Je vertaalt technische differentiatie naar concrete, meetbare klantwaarde en commerciële resultaten. Je ontwikkelt een hecht, resultaatgericht managementteam met duidelijke rollen, eigenaarschap en samenwerking. Je werkt nauw samen met het internationale hoofdkantoor en met de Managing Directors in andere landen. Zelf rapporteer je aan de CEO. Je vertegenwoordigt Interflon op relevante vakbeurzen, BEMAS en andere netwerkevenementen. Ondernemende, inspirerende, commerciële changemanager Je bent een ondernemende en geloofwaardige leider die energie krijgt van groei, verandering en klantencontact. Je weet een commerciële organisatie mee te nemen in een transitie, zonder de pragmatiek en snelheid van een vlakke organisatie te verliezen. Verder breng je mee: Een bachelor- of masterdiploma, bijvoorbeeld in engineering, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting. Minimaal 8–10 jaar ervaring in een commerciële eindverantwoordelijke rol met P&L-verantwoordelijkheid binnen een technische industriële omgeving. Een aantoonbare achtergrond in value-based selling, consultative selling en business development. Het vermogen om technische voordelen te vertalen naar financiële en operationele klantwaarde.
